page.overview:
What is Eye of the Beholder?

Eye of the Beholder is the third track from Metallica's 1988's album ...And Justice For All. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Kirk Hammett.

"The Eye of the Beholder" is about freedom and it is only as true as you perceive it. It protests against the restricted limit of freedom by the law.

Lars has stated in interviews that he doesn't like the song, much in the same way that James dislikes "Escape" from 1984's Ride the Lightning.

Do you see what I see? Truth is an offence Your silence for your confidence
